description: Run by the content-piece process. context: loads the piece and the confirmed Brand Kit, works out the review and publish dates, saves them on the piece and puts the job on the WorkQ calendar. check: runs the brand and compliance checks and comments the results on the job. file: saves the approved draft as .md and .docx under the drafts folder for its content type. posted / skipped: kept as steps for when automations can move a record stage; they change nothing yet. Uses no AI and sends nothing.
